lines.en: label day351:
scene impromptumalltrip1
So-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: It appears that, thankfully, the last reset did not bring with it the reckoning of all of my new students.
lines.zh: 看来谢天谢地，上一次重置并没有把我那些新学生一并清算掉。

lines.en: In fact, we were able to make it through the day with almost near perfect attendance.
lines.zh: 事实上，我们今天几乎全员到齐地撑了过来。

lines.en: The only exceptions to that being the usual Yumi and Ayane who, after talking to Ami about it, wanted to take the day off for...mental health reasons or something like that.
lines.zh: 唯一的例外还是老样子：Yumi 和 Ayane。Ami 跟她们谈过之后，说想请一天假，理由是……心理健康之类的。

lines.en: I don’t know. The type of excuse or reason or whatever you want to call it doesn’t really matter to me because, as I’m sure you know-
lines.zh: 我也不知道。到底是借口还是理由，随便你怎么叫，对我来说都无所谓，因为——你肯定也清楚——

lines.en: I am incredibly bad at my job.
lines.zh: 我的工作干得烂透了。

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip2
: Hm? What is it?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Thanks for all that you do.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你做的一切。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip3
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Did I hear that correctly?
lines.zh: : 我没听错吧？

lines.en: : Did you...actually just thank me for something?
lines.zh: : 你……真的刚刚在谢我？

lines.en: : Have I not done that before?
lines.zh: : 我以前没做过吗？

lines.en: : Not as spontaneously as that...
lines.zh: : 可没这么突然过……

lines.en: : You’re not sick, are you?
lines.zh: : 你没生病吧？

lines.en: : I’m very sick.
lines.zh: : 我病得很重。

lines.en: : {i}Lovesick.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}害的是相思病。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip4
: And you’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 还有，不用谢。

lines.en: : Though, I do wish you’d start applying some of the knowledge I know you have buried in that head of yours to-
lines.zh: : 不过我真希望你能把埋在你那颗脑袋里的知识拿出一点来用——

lines.en: : Oh, look. Ami and friends.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。Ami 和她的朋友们。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip5
I cordially finish my conversation with Makoto and she accepts wholeheartedly that she is now the full time teacher of the classroom.
lines.zh: 我客气地结束了和 Makoto 的对话，而她也由衷地接受了「自己现在是这个教室的全职老师」这一事实。

lines.en: : Thank you for only addressing me by name and leaving these other girls to rot.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你只提了我的名字，让这些姑娘自生自灭。

lines.en: : That’s not really what-
lines.zh: : 其实不是——

lines.en: : Sensei! Guess what?
lines.zh: : Sensei！你猜怎么着？

lines.en: : What, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 什么，Noriko？

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip6
: I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : Oh please.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。

lines.en: : And also that we’re going to be visiting Ayane today and wanted to know if you wanted to come.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，我们今天要去看 Ayane，想知道你要不要一起去。

lines.en: : Was the love part really necessary, then?
lines.zh: : 那「爱你」那部分是必要的吗？

lines.en: : No. But I felt it bubbling up inside and if I didn’t get it out I probably would have started screaming or something.
lines.zh: : 不必要。但我感觉它在心里冒泡，要是不说出来的话，我大概就要尖叫了之类的。

lines.en: : I understand what you mean...but if you say it again, I will end you.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思……但你再说一遍，我就把你了结了。

lines.en: : Overwhelming feelings for me aside, I thought Ayane was just taking a “mental health day,” whatever that means.
lines.zh: : 先不谈对我那汹涌澎湃的感情，我还以为 Ayane 只是休个「心理健康日」，不管那是什么意思。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip7
: You should probably know what it means. I’m pretty sure you could use a few of those yourself.
lines.zh: : 你大概该知道那是什么意思。我很确定你自己也该休几个。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Sensei is in perfect mental health and everything he’ll ever need comes in a tiny package called Ami.
lines.zh: : 胡说。Sensei 心理状况完美无缺，他需要的一切都装在一个叫 Ami 的小包装里。

lines.en: : Or the more deluxe version called Noriko.
lines.zh: : 或者叫 Noriko 的豪华版。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip8
: You’re not deluxe just because you're really pretty and...have really nice skin!
lines.zh: : 你才不豪华呢，不就是长得特别漂亮……皮肤特别好吗！

lines.en: : And a famous sister who may or may not sing my favorite song!
lines.zh: : 还有个出名的姐姐，说不定唱过我最喜欢的那首歌！

lines.en: : And really nice skin!
lines.zh: : 还有皮肤特别好！

lines.en: : Shut up! I hate you!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我恨你！

lines.en: : Does it get exhausting having to deal with things like this all the time?
lines.zh: : 天天得应付这种事，会不会很累？

lines.en: : Nope. This is my life now and I accept all of it.
lines.zh: : 不累。这就是我现在的生活，我全盘接受。

lines.en: : Yippee.
lines.zh: : 好耶。

lines.en: : Anyway, are you coming with us or not?
lines.zh: : 总之，你到底来不来？

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == True or ayanelust10 == True:
: Why are you even going?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么要去？

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip9
: What do you mean “Why am I going?”
lines.zh: : 「我为什么要去」是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that if you’re just looking to torment Ayane, which you really shouldn’t, going to her room to do it might be a little too harsh for even you.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你只是想去折磨 Ayane——你真不该这么做——那跑到她房间去折磨她，就算对你来说也有点太狠了。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip10
: The fuck do you mean “even me?”
lines.zh: : 「就算对我」你他妈是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure you know exactly what I mean, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我很确定你完全明白我的意思，Kirin。

lines.en: : No, Sensei. Please explain my relationship with Ayane to me because you seem to {i}completely{/i} understand it while I don’t.
lines.zh: : 不，Sensei。请你给我解释一下我和 Ayane 的关系吧，因为你似乎{i}完全{/i}懂，而我一点都不懂。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip11
: Uhh...everything okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……你们还好吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And Sensei obviously isn’t coming, so let’s just go now.
lines.zh: : 没事。Sensei 显然不来了，那我们现在就走吧。

lines.en: else:
scene impromptumalltrip12
: If there’s anything that’s sure to cheer up Ayane, it’s seeing her favorite man in the whole wide world showing up at her door with a bunch of really close friends.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么一定能哄 Ayane 开心，那就是让她在这世上最喜欢的男人带着一群特别亲密的朋友出现在她门口。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize Noriko and Ayane were “close friends.”
lines.zh: : 我还不知道 Noriko 和 Ayane 是「亲密朋友」呢。

lines.en: : I’d say we’re more like comrades in arms. We can bond over our shared interest in one day marrying you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们更像战友。我们可以靠着「总有一天要嫁给你」这个共同爱好建立起羁绊。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip8
: If anyone is marrying Sensei it’s me! I’m his [niece], so I deserve it!
lines.zh: : 要嫁给 Sensei 也只能是我！我是他的[niece]，所以我配得上！

lines.en: : Are you really going to just let her yell something like that?
lines.zh: : 你真就任由她喊出这种话？

lines.en: : I’ve learned by now that I don’t really have a choice.
lines.zh: : 我早就明白了，这事我其实没得选。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip13
: But, either way, I think I’ll sit this one out.
lines.zh: : 不过不管怎样，这次我就不去了。

lines.en: : You’re...really not coming?
lines.zh: : 你……真的不来吗？

lines.en: : You’re worried about her too, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你也在担心她，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course. But I think Ayane might just want to be left alone right now.
lines.zh: : 当然。但我觉得 Ayane 现在可能只想一个人待着。

lines.en: : I know if I was trying to fix my mental health, the last thing I’d want is a bunch of people showing up at my door and trying to force me to feel better.
lines.zh: : 我知道，如果换我在努力修复自己的心理健康，我最不想要的就是一群人堵在我门口，硬要我开心起来。

lines.en: : You’re not really like everybody else, though. What Ayane wants might be a little different.
lines.zh: : 可你跟别人不一样啊。Ayane 想要的也许会有点不同。

lines.en: I don’t think it is.
lines.zh: 我不这么认为。

lines.en: I still don’t fully understand what’s been going through her head lately, but I do think I’ve come to learn just what it is that can make her feel better.
lines.zh: 我依然不完全理解她最近脑子里在想什么，但我确实慢慢弄明白了，究竟什么能让她好受一些。

lines.en: Apart from my penis, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，除了我的鸡巴之外。

lines.en: And that’s to wallow in her own self-doubt until it dissipates and becomes easier to ignore.
lines.zh: 那就是沉溺在自己的自我怀疑里，直到它慢慢消散，变得更容易被无视。

lines.en: These three will fail miserably today.
lines.zh: 这三个今天会惨败而归。

lines.en: : Anyway, tell Ayane that I hope she feels better soon.
lines.zh: : 总之，替我转告 Ayane，希望她早点好起来。

lines.en: : Class is eerily quiet without her.
lines.zh: : 没有她在，教室里安静得有点瘆人。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip14
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : And if there’s anything {i}else{/i} you’d like me to give her in your absence, please do tell.
lines.zh: : 还有，你不在场的情况下，要是有什么{i}别的{/i}东西想让我转交给她，尽管开口。

lines.en: : Like maybe a big old banana or something else that would remind her of you.
lines.zh: : 比如一根又大又老的香蕉，或者其他什么能让她想起你的东西。

lines.en: : Ayane does love bananas.
lines.zh: : Ayane 确实喜欢香蕉。

lines.en: : I...think Kirin may have been insinuating something else.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得 Kirin 可能是在暗示别的东西。

lines.en: : Bananas are a good source of potassium.
lines.zh: : 香蕉富含钾元素。

lines.en: : Very good, Ami. Thank you for paying attention to Makoto’s lecture on nutrients earlier today.
lines.zh: : 很好，Ami。谢谢你今天早些时候认真听了 Makoto 讲营养。

lines.en: : Does potassium make girls feel better when they’re sad?
lines.zh: : 钾能让女孩子伤心的时候好受点吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But it does help take some of the pain away.
lines.zh: : 不太行。不过确实能缓解一些痛苦。

lines.en: : Uhh...Anyway, I guess the three of us will just start heading over to the dorms.
lines.zh: : 呃……总之，我们三个就先去宿舍那边了。

lines.en: : What are you going to do in the meantime?
lines.zh: : 你这段时间打算干什么？

lines.en: : Probably try to go home and then get stopped by another one of you girls on the way.
lines.zh: : 大概是想回家，然后在路上被你们其中某个姑娘拦下来。

lines.en: : Well, whoever it is, make sure that you tell them you’re off limits and that you’ll be too busy thinking of me to pay any attention to them today.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管是谁，你一定要告诉她们你名草有主了，而且今天你会忙着想我，根本顾不上理她们。

lines.en: : Or any day.
lines.zh: : 哪天都一样。

lines.en: : I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我好爱你。

lines.en: : Hooray. Now I want to puke.
lines.zh: : 好耶。现在我想吐了。

lines.en: scene black
Ami, Kirin, and Noriko exit the classroom. And since the day has already come to an end, the rest of the girls begin to filter out as well.
lines.zh: Ami、Kirin 和 Noriko 走出教室。既然一天已经结束，其余的女孩也开始陆续离开。

lines.en: I decided earlier that everyone is completely okay mentally and that it’s fine for me to skip my office hours every once in a while, so I quickly make my way downstairs and begin to head home.
lines.zh: 我之前就认定了大家心理状况完全没问题，偶尔翘一次答疑时间也无妨，于是我快步下楼，动身回家。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip15
Fortunately, I’m able to make it to the lockers without being spotted by-
lines.zh: 幸运的是，我一路走到了鞋柜那边，没被——

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip16
: Stop right there, mister!
lines.zh: : 站住，先生！

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : This better be you finally accepting my marriage proposal, Uta.
lines.zh: : 最好是你终于接受我的求婚了，Uta。

lines.en: : Careful, Sensei! If Ami hears you, she’ll chop both of our heads off and make hamburger meat out of them!
lines.zh: : 小心点，Sensei！要是 Ami 听见了，她会把我们俩的脑袋都砍下来，剁成汉堡肉饼！

lines.en: : Oh, right. I’m supposed to tell you that I’m only going to think about her today.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我得告诉你，我今天只会想着她。

lines.en: : Even if I come to you today with a once in a lifetime opportunity to see me in less clothing than normal?
lines.zh: : 就算我今天给你带来一个千载难逢的机会，能看我穿得比平时更少，也不行？

lines.en: : Wait, who is Ami again?
lines.zh: : 等等，Ami 是谁来着？

lines.en: : That’s the Sensei I know!
lines.zh: : 这才是我认识的 Sensei！

lines.en: : Now, get on over here and listen to my proposition!
lines.zh: : 好了，快过来听听我的提案！

lines.en: scene black
I turn fully around to find that Futaba is here as well, but had been lingering off to the side to avoid being embarrassed by Uta’s entrepreneurial “hook.”
lines.zh: 我完全转过身，发现 Futaba 也在，只是一直躲在旁边，免得被 Uta 那套创业「噱头」弄得难堪。

lines.en: The three of us agree to have a threesome and quickly make our way back to-
lines.zh: 我们三个一致同意来一场三人行，然后迅速动身回到——

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip17
: Now before you go gettin’ all rock hard on us, I wanna make it clear this isn’t a sexual thingy.
lines.zh: : 在你对我们硬邦邦起来之前，我先把话说清楚，这可不是什么色情的事儿。

lines.en: : That’s a detail you should have informed me of before I stopped walking.
lines.zh: : 这可是你在我停下脚步之前就该告诉我的细节。

lines.en: : Hey now. Just cause it won’t be sexual doesn’t mean you won’t still have a good time!
lines.zh: : 哎嘿。就算不涉及色情，也不代表你不会玩得开心啊！

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Um...can we maybe not...talk about things like this in the hallway?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们能不能别……在走廊里聊这种事？

lines.en: : It might attract...unnecessary attention.
lines.zh: : 可能会引来……不必要的注意。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip18
: What’s goin’ on? I came runnin’ when I heard the naughty talk and had a feeling that Sensei was gonna be involved somehow.
lines.zh: : 怎么了怎么了？我一听到下流话就跑过来了，直觉告诉我肯定有 Sensei 的份。

lines.en: : Well, it was certainly a good hunch, Miku. But I don’t know if whatever Uta’s plan is will work with four people.
lines.zh: : 嗯，直觉相当准，Miku。不过我不知道 Uta 的计划四个人还行不行得通。

lines.en: : Actually, Miku being here makes things even better! We can hit all three food groups at once!
lines.zh: : 其实 Miku 在这儿反而更好！我们可以一次集齐三大食物群！

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip19
: Food groups? You three goin’ out to eat or somethin’?!
lines.zh: : 食物群？你们三个要去吃饭还是啥？！

lines.en: : Can I come?!
lines.zh: : 我能去吗？！

lines.en: : Food groups as in boobies, Miku.
lines.zh: : 是胸部意义上的食物群，Miku。

lines.en: : We’ve got the voluptuous beauty, the short stack, and now the washboard!
lines.zh: : 我们有丰乳美人、小个子，现在又多了块搓衣板！

lines.en: : Umm...Uta?...
lines.zh: : 呃……Uta？……

lines.en: : Miku is a little self conscious about-
lines.zh: : Miku 对自己的……有点自卑……

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip20
: I’ll fuckin’ kill you! You think you’re so great because of those friggin’ fat bags on your chest!
lines.zh: : 我他妈杀了你！你以为你胸前挂着那两个该死的肥袋子就了不起了？！

lines.en: : Just wait until they’re draggin’ across the ground in twenty years, damn it! Then you’ll be beggin’ to be me!
lines.zh: : 等着吧，二十年后它们垂到地上拖着走的时候！到时候你求着要变成我呢，混蛋！

lines.en: : ...her chest.
lines.zh: : ……她的胸。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to be self conscious about, Miku. I personally love {i}all{/i} boobies and I’m sure that Sensei is in the same boat.
lines.zh: : 没什么好自卑的，Miku。我个人{i}所有{/i}胸部都喜欢，而且我敢肯定 Sensei 也一样。

lines.en: : Confirmed.
lines.zh: : 确认无误。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip21
: Still doesn’t really explain why you’re gathered in the hall talkin’ about it...
lines.zh: : 可这还是没解释你们为什么聚在走廊里聊这个……

lines.en: : Because Uta hasn’t...really gotten to the whole reason for this yet.
lines.zh: : 因为 Uta 还没……真正说到这件事的缘由。

lines.en: : I {i}was{/i} gettin’ there when our latest participant showed up.
lines.zh: : 我{i}正{/i}要说呢，我们最新的参与者就冒出来了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Futaba and I were gonna go to the mall to try on new swimsuits for the beach! Do you have any idea what this means?
lines.zh: : Sensei！我和 Futaba 要去商场试海滩穿的新泳衣！你知道这意味着什么吗？

lines.en: : That you’re likely going to develop hypothermia sometime in the near future.
lines.zh: : 意味着你很可能在不久的将来患上失温症。

lines.en: : Possibly! But also that we need the judgement of a lecher like yourself to know if we’re cute or not!
lines.zh: : 有可能！不过也意味着我们需要像你这样的色鬼来评判一下我们到底可不可爱！

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip22
: Well...I do kinda want a new swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我其实也挺想要件新泳衣的。

lines.en: : I like my one piece and stuff...but it kinda takes away a lot of the fun of the water if I can’t feel wet all over, ya know?
lines.zh: : 我挺喜欢我那件连体的……不过要是没法浑身都湿透，玩水的乐趣就少了好多，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Please...watch the way you word things, Miku...
lines.zh: : 拜托……注意一下你的措辞，Miku……

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip23
: Hm? There somethin’ wrong with bein’ all wet?
lines.zh: : 嗯？浑身湿透有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : You can’t possibly turn this down {i}now,{/i} can you?
lines.zh: : {i}这下{/i}你总不可能拒绝了吧？

lines.en: : Oh, I’ve been aboard since the whole “less clothing” thing. I just wanted to see if this conversation would go anywhere exciting.
lines.zh: : 哦，从「穿得更少」那句话开始我就上船了。我只是想看看这段对话会不会往什么刺激的方向发展。

lines.en: : I was not let down.
lines.zh: : 我没失望。

lines.en: scene impromptumalltrip24
: How is getting wet naughty?! It’s totally natural!
lines.zh: : 湿透了怎么就下流了？！这很自然啊！

lines.en: : That it is, Miku.
lines.zh: : 确实自然，Miku。

lines.en: : That it is...
lines.zh: : 确实自然……

lines.en: scene wintersky
The four of us leave the[school] together and I’m forced to basically jog alongside all of them in order to make it to the bus stop on time.
lines.zh: 我们四个一起离开[school]，为了赶上公交，我被迫基本上一路小跑地跟在她们旁边。

lines.en: And when I say “jog” I basically mean speed walk...but I consider pretty much everything faster than walking as some form of running because I hate all of them and want no part of any.
lines.zh: 而我说的「小跑」基本就是快走……不过我把任何比走路快的东西都算作某种跑步，因为我恨透了所有这些，一点都不想沾边。

lines.en: Either way, we manage to make it to the bus stop right as the bus gets there and the speed-jog-running pays off in saving us a grand total of maybe thirty minutes overall.
